Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer made a fundamental error in Step 1 by attempting to use Zillow as the primary data source. Zillow is a United States-only real estate platform and does not have data for properties in Prince Edward Island, Canada. This initial choice of tool was incorrect because it violated the constraint of the task (finding data for PEI) and the known limitations of the specified tool, leading to a complete failure to retrieve any relevant listings from the very first attempt.
